Read the simulated Falco alerts first: kubectl get configmap falco-simulation -n dojo-sec-falco -o jsonpath='{.data.alerts}' — identify the 3 rules that fired and understand what each detects.

Write /tmp/custom-falco-rule.yaml with these required fields: rule (name), condition (using evt.type, container, proc.name), output (message with %field% substitutions), priority (WARNING/ERROR/etc). The rule should detect 'ls' running inside a container.
Your condition should be: evt.type = execve and container and proc.name = "ls" — save this in /tmp/custom-falco-rule.yaml then run bash verify.sh
